openings.claim: A shared fresh start may reduce familiarity disadvantage independently of pairing delay.
openings.discriminator: Occasional attendees improve despite unchanged formation time.
openings.fit: Preserves repeated structure and voluntary participation.
openings.probe: Alternate ordinary and fresh prompts with equal turns; observe speaking, formation time and switches; collect usefulness by optional attendance frequency.
openings.uncertainty: Freshness may not resolve familiarity asymmetry.

openings.claim: Dates and one marked next task may resolve temporal confusion.
openings.discriminator: Earlier-task errors fall; blanks may indicate access or comprehension problems.
openings.fit: Existing paper, spare sheets and optional messages; no attendance prerequisite.
openings.probe: Date current/next sessions; distinguish correct, earlier and blank responses, optionally by paper-only use; log printing and questions.
openings.uncertainty: Date comprehension and low added workload are assumed.

openings.claim: Unseen personal content creates information gaps; private optional scaffolds support differing levels; adjacent seating reduces matching decisions.
openings.discriminator: Easier entry, shorter pairing delays and more balanced speech than ordinary rounds.
openings.fit: No public labels; allow switches and odd-number triads.
openings.probe: Counterbalance ordinary/fresh-gap rounds; alternate explaining/questions; observe individual speech and delay; collect round-specific usefulness and entry difficulty.
openings.uncertainty: Bundled mechanisms, support selection and setup cost remain uncertain.

openings.claim: A reusable invitation tied to next attendance may remove sequential-task confusion.
openings.discriminator: Occasional attendees identify preparation better; questions decrease while material supports conversation.
openings.fit: Printed card, optional topic examples and immediate examples for unprepared arrivals.
openings.probe: Invite an experience/object/question; include opening exchange; record next action, useful speaking, missing responses and coordination by activity.
openings.uncertainty: Recurring invitation may lose motivation or fail across levels.

decision: Retain four hypotheses for six-session probes. Preserve free inclusive conversation, offline preparation, 75-minute room limit and no paid time. Check all thresholds together: 80% report ten useful minutes, 85% identify preparation, coordination below 90 minutes. Baseline is 72 unlinked slips across 97 attendances with no direct timing; causes and representativeness remain unknown.
